sourceRecords.sourceTitle: Altos Labs launches with cellular rejuvenation programming goal
sourceRecords.locator: Altos Labs release distributed by PR Newswire, 19 Jan 2022
sourceRecords.shortExcerpt: Altos launched as a biotechnology company with USD 3bn committed, cellular rejuvenation focus and global institute plans.

originatingSource.sourceTitle: Altos Labs launches with cellular rejuvenation programming goal

observedFacts.statement: Altos Labs launched with USD 3 billion fully committed from investors.
Altos Labs described its focus as cellular rejuvenation programming to restore cell health and resilience.
Altos said it would initially be based in the San Francisco Bay Area, San Diego and Cambridge, UK, with collaborations in Japan.
Altos said Shinya Yamanaka would serve as senior scientific advisor without remuneration.

sourceRecords.sourceTitle: Prof. Shinya Yamanaka serves as senior scientific advisor to Altos Labs
sourceRecords.shortExcerpt: Kyoto University's CiRA confirmed Yamanaka's unpaid Altos advisor role and Japan research collaboration plans.

originatingSource.sourceTitle: Prof. Shinya Yamanaka serves as senior scientific advisor to Altos Labs

observedFacts.statement: CiRA reported that Shinya Yamanaka would serve as an unpaid senior scientific advisor to Altos Labs.
CiRA reported that Altos would provide funds for research projects in cellular rejuvenation programming in Japan.

sourceRecords.sourceTitle: Rejuvenation by controlled reprogramming is the latest gambit in anti-aging
sourceRecords.shortExcerpt: Nature Biotechnology covered Altos' launch, its USD 3bn initial financing and the partial reprogramming thesis.

originatingSource.sourceTitle: Rejuvenation by controlled reprogramming is the latest gambit in anti-aging

observedFacts.statement: Nature Biotechnology reported Altos launched with USD 3 billion in initial financing.
Nature Biotechnology described controlled partial reprogramming as the scientific thesis behind Altos and similar ventures.

failedNotes.note: The launch sources do not disclose product cash-flow forecasts, commercial products, clinical-stage assets or security-level terms.
